lines.text: David sends messengers to console Hanun, but Hanun shaves their beards and cuts off their garments at the hips.
David tells his humiliated men to stay in Hebron until their beards have grown back.
Joab arrays the best men against the Arameans and puts Abishai over the rest against the Ammonites.
David crosses the Jordan, defeats the Arameans, and kills seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers.
David takes the Ammonite king's crown, which weighs a talent of silver and is set with precious stones.
